digest.component_or_area: verifier resumption and search-frontier exclusion mechanism
propositions: Frontier exclusion-list data block spliced into ticket context does not reduce re-search overlap; treatment arm showed +78% and +60% relative overlap INCREASE versus control on both corpus tickets
Frontier block inside untrusted fence is rendered inert by design and when read, acts as a signpost causing model to immediately re-read listed files, raising measured overlap rather than reducing it

Cache-seeding mechanism (locust behavior) already removes dominant redundancy of re-proving credited criteria; remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be effectively suppressed by data-shaped exclusion list
PoC decision rule failed on both criteria for both tickets: 45c1 and 8d74 both failed the >=30% relative overlap reduction requirement, preventing GO verdict
